title: Waterfall Wonders Hiking Tour with Brewery Stop from Nashville
includes: See up to 4 waterfalls and learn the history of each
Visit to Old Stone Fort State Archaeological Park and Rutledge Falls
1 drink of choice at Brewery (Alcoholic or Non-Alcoholic)
Visit to Common John Brewing Co before heading back to Nashville
Half Day Waterfall Wonders Hiking Tour from Nashville
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
During this half-day hiking tour, we'll see up to 4 waterfalls in two different state parks and natural areas, learn the history and the prehistoric wonders of the area, and hike around 3-4 miles. 

As we explore, you'll have the chance to spot and learn about the diverse plant and animal life that calls this place home. We'll have opportunities for great photos and great memories as we explore Tennessee's lush landscapes and scenic waterfalls!

After our adventures, we'll round out the day at a local restaurant and brewery before heading back to Nashville
